name: notify-channels-param
prompt: Broadcast should take the channels it sends on as a parameter: give notify.Broadcast a last parameter channels []Notifier and send on it in place of c.Channels, with every call passing the channels its Config holds, so behaviour does not change. Keep the parameter c.

name: notify-broadcast-args
prompt: Bundle the parameters of notify.Broadcast into one struct, notify.BroadcastArgs, with a field for each parameter named as the parameter is (c, users and m): Broadcast takes a BroadcastArgs, and every call passes one, so behaviour does not change.
